svg.title: S3 coroutine operation flow
svg.desc: S3 coroutine helpers convert typed input into async SDK calls, await results, expose paged listing as Flow, and make move rollback behavior explicit.
svg.text: Suspend helpers keep AWS SDK behavior visible while removing CompletableFuture plumbing from application code.
typed overloads produce request bodies and await S3AsyncClient responses
collection starts ListObjectsV2 calls and follows continuation tokens
large-object helpers wait on S3TransferManager completion futures
normal move can be partial; atomic move rolls back the copied destination object
bucket, key, and content length checks happen before SDK calls.
missing list tokens and rollback failures surface as exceptions.
Application code gets suspend and Flow APIs while S3 response, pagination, transfer, and move boundaries remain explicit.
